name: comic-production-studio
description: Modular monolith desktop foundation for Comic Production Studio

scripts.build: tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json && vite build --config apps/desktop/vite.config.ts && esbuild apps/desktop/src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --outfile=apps/desktop/dist-electron/main.js && esbuild apps/desktop/src/main/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=apps/desktop/dist-electron/preload.cjs
